<script>
  (function () {
    const titleToggles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".wp-title-toggle"));

    function syncHashTarget() {
      const id = decodeURIComponent(window.location.hash.replace(/^#/, ""));
      if (!id) return;

      const target = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!target || !target.classList.contains("wp-item")) return;

      target.open = true;
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }, 50);
    }

    for (const titleToggle of titleToggles) {
      titleToggle.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        const item = titleToggle.closest(".wp-item");
        if (!item) return;

        const shouldOpen = !item.open;
        event.stopPropagation();
        event.preventDefault();
        const id = titleToggle.dataset.hash;
        if (!id) return;
        history.replaceState(null, "", `#${id}`);

        item.open = shouldOpen;
        if (shouldOpen) {
          syncHashTarget();
        }
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener("hashchange", syncHashTarget);
    syncHashTarget();
  })();
</script>
